pages.title: The Scenting Box
pages.text: The Scenting Box has 4 slots: a tea slot, a flower slot, a fuel slot and an output slot. It needs fuel to run, and each batch takes 400 ticks (20 seconds).$(br2)The tea slot accepts only scentable finished tea leaves; the flower slot accepts only Jasmine Flower or Gardenia Flower.

pages.title: Scented Products
pages.text: The result is the matching scented tea: tea leaves plus jasmine give Jasmine Scented Tea Leaves, and tea leaves plus gardenia give Gardenia Scented Tea Leaves.$(br2)Brew a scented leaf through the normal process to get Jasmine Flower Tea or Gardenia Flower Tea.

pages.title: Manual Use and Automation
pages.text: Manual use: insert tea leaves from above, and flowers plus fuel from below.$(br2)Automation: tea leaves enter through the top face, fuel through the bottom face, and flowers through the upper half; the output slot can be extracted by pipes.

pages.title: Collecting and Growing Flowers
pages.text: Jasmine and gardenia flowers can be collected from wild jasmine and gardenia bushes.$(br2)1 flower shapelessly crafts into 2 matching seeds (Jasmine Seed / Gardenia Seed); plant the seeds on farmland to grow a bush.
